Anyway airline tweets are boring and cringe but good god @KenyaAirways has pushed me to my absolute limit. If I didn’t have checked baggage I’d get off here in Bangkok and buy one of the many many many connecting flights home. Instead I’m en route to Guangzhou, for reasons.

Also always fun to see the desk agent at @KenyaAirways let people who bribe their way to the front of the line cut in front of us as we were being checked in (as in, she had our passports and was in the process of weighing our luggage). Then once at the gate - the gate, about to board the plane, not the desk - the agent decided to inform us we had checked too many bags. I think the time to tell us that is when we are… checking the bags? (Also, it turns out that we had not checked too many bags,

I feel like if airlines do this, they should have to compensate you for the time of yours that they’ve wasted, especially if they add a whole extra leg to your flight. Like how is it that I can book a route that *still exists* and they can just be like, actually nah, we’re gonna randomly fly you to Guangzhou for fun.

The only responsibility I feel right now, along with many others in Germany,  is to keep bookmarking moments like this, so that people here don't turn around and tell the rest of the world "we had no idea what was happening". They know. Everyone knows. At best - at best - they don't want to see it.
